reviewer_role: independently delegated paper architect/reviewer, not the executor
intended_claim: DRL trained on large complex parent scenes, frozen for variable-size complete local planning, with positive independent quality increment over both matched supervised controls and the original rapid-deployment thresholds.
what_results_support: Fixed frozen endpoints produce auditable proxy-constraint complete local plans at 4x3, 6x6 and 8x8 in the declared saved cases; successful results retain whole-parent geometry and source identity.
The 13817 newly authorized unexecuted requests completed without a new failure, while 2057 inherited successes and two failed historical slots retain their original debit and missingness.
Common H improves identical saved RL raw routes by 16.347%-21.548% in the five complete quality cells. This is postprocessing benefit, not neural policy or independent DRL benefit.
Training pipeline raw routes outperform untrained raw routes, but supervised initialization is part of that pipeline and both supervised controls outperform RL raw routes.
what_results_dont_support: A positive independent DRL quality increment: RL+H parent-relative mean gain versus frozenSL is -1.102% to -1.956% and versus continuedSL -1.070% to -2.319% across all five complete cells; every complete quality cell fails the unchanged original gate.
A cross-size quality advantage over strong native rules: complete-cell RL+H costs are 2.304%-5.532% higher than Fixed3 and 3.720%-7.519% higher than Detour16.

The registered rapid-planning/deployment goal: all nine complete deployment strata fail. Median time ratios versus Detour16 are 1.765-2.716, p95 ratios 1.574-2.644; Fixed3 dominates all nine complete strata.
A complete six-quality/twelve-deployment AND pass, or successful completion of the unamended original-v3 scientific grid.
True IK, arm swept-path, joint trajectory or hardware safety certification; pure-gradient or equal-FLOPs causal benefit; treating repeated requests as independent layouts.

Positive independent DRL increment and rapid-deployment evidence meeting the already frozen gates. These are substantive failures in complete cells, not just missing-data gaps.

Real kinematic, arm collision and joint-path evidence for any future physical-execution claim; such claims are outside the present proxy evidence.
